2 You are provided with solution A and solid B.
Do the following tests on the substances, recording all of your observations at each stage.
tests on solution A

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Carry out a flame test on solution A.
Record your observations.

Divide the remaining solution A into four approximately equal portions in one boiling tube and three
test-tubes.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
To the first portion of solution A in a boiling tube add aqueous ammonia dropwise until it is in
excess.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
To the second portion of solution A add about 1cm depth of dilute nitric acid followed by a few
drops of aqueous silver nitrate.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Add the third portion of solution A to the test-tube containing aqueous chlorine.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
To the fourth portion of solution A add the magnesium ribbon.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (f)
parts.text:
Identify the three ions contained in solution A.

tests on solid B
Add about 15cm of distilled water to the boiling tube containing solid B. Replace the stopper in the
boiling tube and shake the boiling tube to dissolve as much solid B as possible and form solution B.
Filter the mixture formed and collect solution B as the filtrate. Divide solution B into three
approximately equal portions in three test-tubes.

parts.label: (g)
parts.text:
Test the pH of the first portion of solution B.
pH = ______

parts.label: (h)
parts.text:
To the second portion of solution B add aqueous sodium hydroxide dropwise and then in
excess.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
To the third portion of solution B add aqueous ammonia dropwise and then in excess.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (j)
parts.text:
Identify solid B.

3 Fizzy drinks contain carbon dioxide gas dissolved in a liquid. The carbon dioxide gas can be
removed from the fizzy drink by heating.
Plan an investigation to find the volume of carbon dioxide gas in 1dm of a fizzy drink.
Include in your answer how you will calculate the volume of carbon dioxide gas dissolved in 1dm
of a fizzy drink.

apparatus.
